column1: # Ground truth for `eidolon validate`, OBSERVED not assumed.
# Captured by running each corpus file through the real tools. Versions tested:
#   bcftools 1.17, 1.19, 1.22      (agreed exactly; 1.22 is the Delta target)
# Delta runs samtools 1.22, which could not be tested locally — the differential
# test asserts ACCEPT/REJECT agreement rather than message equality, because
# messages drift across versions while verdicts have proven stable.
# The operation matters: `bcftools view` accepts unsorted input, `tabix` rejects it;
# `bcftools view` accepts REF=Z, `bcftools norm -f` rejects it. A citation naming only
# the tool would be wrong. My first pass recorded REF=Z as "no tool catches this",
# which was false — I had not tried norm.
